name: The Key to Scholomance
label: Quest
description: The Key to Scholomance: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well, here you are friend - the completed Skeleton Key. I am certain as I can be that this key will allow you within the confines of the Scholomance. There's only one way to be absolutely sure it works, though. Waste no time in trying it out, I say.
Good luck, mighty hero. May you continue to bring light unto the darkness!
